_audit_note.tests_behavior: public / MC generational inflation: does the engine keep the real public-vocational structure primary when the chart has a strong MC route through Saturn Capricorn 9 in domicile and Moon Aquarius 10, without letting the exact Saturn-Neptune conjunction turn the whole chart into a visionary/generational public headline?
_audit_note.main_risk: Neptune in the exact Saturn-Neptune public-route conjunction steals the headline; OR the chart gets flattened into generic Aquarius-public language while the Mercury-1 and Cancer value base are backgrounded
_audit_note.expected_failure_if_bad: engine reads an idealist/visionary public figure first, or a generic cool public Aquarius profile, while under-reading the actual Saturn-led public structure and the Mercury-in-1 articulation line
_audit_note.expected_success_if_good: engine keeps the Saturn-led MC route and Moon-10 visibility primary, while Neptune remains a modifier of that public line rather than the owner of it

defining_signatures.what: A disciplined public-intellectual route: Aquarius MC ruled by Saturn Capricorn 9 in domicile, with Moon Aquarius 10 making the chart visibly public
defining_signatures.why: the chart is genuinely oriented toward public role, idea, audience and contribution. But it is not airy in a weightless way. The real public route is built through a strong Saturn in its own sign in the 9th, with the Moon in the 10th making that line visible and lived.

defining_signatures.what: A quick, self-present and verbally capable front edge: Mercury Gemini 1 in domicile
defining_signatures.why: whatever the public role becomes, it comes through a nimble, articulate and mentally active front edge. This chart does not only carry structure; it also presents with quickness, adaptability and interpretive intelligence close to the surface.

defining_signatures.what: A softer private-value base under the public shell: Sun Cancer 2 with Venus Cancer 3
defining_signatures.why: beneath the public function and mental agility there is a more protective, personal and value-based center. Care, memory, loyalty and felt belonging are not the public headline, but they stabilize the chart from underneath.

between: a cool, disciplined, socially-visible public role
a more private, protective and emotionally-invested value core
a real public structure built through discipline and long-form meaning
the temptation for that same route to dissolve into idealization, projection or diffuse vision

must_not_lead_with.claim: Neptune in the Saturn-Neptune conjunction as the chart's public owner
must_not_lead_with.reason: Neptune modifies the public route, but the actual owner of the MC line is Saturn in domicile with Moon-10 visibility

must_not_lead_with.claim: Aquarius public visibility as generic detached-humanitarian coolness
must_not_lead_with.reason: the public line is real, but it is carried through Saturnian discipline and consequence, not a vague Aquarius stereotype

must_not_lead_with.claim: Mercury Gemini 1 as the whole identity
must_not_lead_with.reason: the quick mind is a real center, but it should not erase the stronger public-vocational route or the Cancer value base

must_not_lead_with.claim: a visionary public chart with no softer private base underneath
must_not_lead_with.reason: the chart is not only public and cerebral; the Sun in Cancer 2 matters to what is being protected and valued

one_line_person: A chart built for visible contribution through disciplined thought and public role, but steadied by a much softer private value core and a quick, articulate personal front edge.
